authorization_basis: standing user authorization plus B62 review remediation scope
single_changed_variable: provider-enforced JSON schemas and provider-boundary call accounting
unchanged: two calls and 512 completion-token ceiling per condition
success_condition: four provider-boundary-counted calls complete exact JSON schemas and freeze both predictions with actual token and latency accounting before any future access
failure_condition: any provider, schema, probability, language, accounting, call-count, retry, or future-access violation produces a terminal redacted failure with every attempted call counted
claim_boundary: B63 is an execution remediation. Even success only freezes one-row predictions; it does not establish correctness or advantage before separate outcome unlock and scoring.
